title: EventConfig

dateOfEvent.description: Reference to the field capturing the date of the event (e.g. date of birth). Defaults to the event creation date if unspecified.

$$field.description: Id of the field to reference

$$subfield.description: If the FieldValue is an object, subfield can be used to refer to e.g. `["foo", "bar"]` in `{ foo: { bar: 3 } }`

$$code.description: Serialised client-side function body. When present the expression is evaluated rather than dereferenced.

anyOf.description: Reference to a field value, with an optional client-side computation applied.
Reference to a field defined in the event metadata, using the field id.

placeOfEvent.description: Reference to the field capturing the place of the event (e.g. place of birth). Defaults to the meta.createdAtLocation if unspecified.

$$field.description: Id of the field to reference

$$subfield.description: If the FieldValue is an object, subfield can be used to refer to e.g. `["foo", "bar"]` in `{ foo: { bar: 3 } }`

$$code.description: Serialised client-side function body. When present the expression is evaluated rather than dereferenced.

title.description: Title template for the singular event, supporting variables (e.g. "{applicant.name.firstname} {applicant.name.surname}").

fallbackTitle.description: Fallback title shown when the main title resolves to an empty value.

summary.description: Summary information displayed in the event overview.

label.description: Human-readable label for the event type.

actions.description: Configuration of core and custom actions associated with the event.

actionOrder.description: Order of actions in the action menu. Use either the action type for core actions or the customActionType for custom actions.

declaration.description: Configuration of the form used to gather event data.

advancedSearch.description: Configuration of fields available in the advanced search feature.

flags.description: Configuration of custom flags associated with the actions of this event type.

analytics.description: Indicates whether the records of this event type are included in analytics

description: Configuration defining an event type registered in OpenCRVS (for example birth or death).
